newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech PX50 closes higher in light trading.
newsitem.headline: Czech PX50 closes higher in light trading.

text.p: The Czech PX50 index closed higher on Monday with dealers saying there was little activity apart from some late position squaring from London based investors.
"There was some late squaring of positions...but in fact the market is completely dead," said Petr Koblic of Zivnostenska Banka in Prague.
Koblic said trading had been so thin that many local dealers had stopped trying to make deals after the fixing at 1100 local time (1000 GMT).
The main indices rose slightly. The PX50 was up 0.25 percent to 530.8 while the RPIX index of continuously traded shares gained 0.4 percent to 1,108.
On continuous trading, only three of the index's 10 shares traded at all, with turnover hitting just eight million crowns.
Trading continues on Tuesday but the bourse will be closed on Jan 1 to Jan 3.
